subject.title: ci(ui): raise startup JS gzip budget to 375 KiB

question: After reviewing current PR-head performance output, should the project accept 375 KiB of startup-JS gzip headroom, or should the underlying bundle growth be reduced to retain the 370 KiB guard?
rationale: The correct threshold is a maintainer-owned performance-policy choice; the supplied context reports prior failures but does not include inspectable after-change measurement output.

options.title: Accept 375 KiB with measured proof
options.body: Merge after an exact-head performance check records the startup gzip measurement and confirms that 5 KiB remains an intentionally tight guard.

options.title: Retain the 370 KiB ceiling
options.body: Reject the threshold increase and first reduce startup JavaScript so the existing performance policy continues to pass.

recommendation.title: Accept 375 KiB with measured proof
recommendation.body: Merge after an exact-head performance check records the startup gzip measurement and confirms that 5 KiB remains an intentionally tight guard.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Control UI performance work and the stated budget-change history connect this contributor most directly to the threshold decision.
